spans.s: *sudhā, a delicious drink or nectarlike substance: I, 8322; III, ††13158, ††13161; V, 3614; XIII, 1704, 1807 (nāgānāṃ), 2030, 3387, 3388 (nāgānāṃ), 5287, 5302, 5313, 5332.
Sudhanus, a Kuru warrior. § 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 18, 741 (among the Saṃśaptakas who attacked Arjuna).

Sudhanvan^1, a brahman of Aṅgiras' race. § 300 (Prahlāda): II, 68, 2315 (Āṅgirasaṃ), 2318, 2320, 2335, (2336) (his rivalry with Virocana [on account of Keśinī]. cf. § 558).-§ 557 (Prajāgarap.): V, 33, 1073 (itihāsaṃ purātanaṃ putrārtham Asurendreṇa (i.e. Prahlāda) gītañ caiva Sºnā, cf. § 558).--§ 558 (Virocana): V, 35, 1185 (Virocanasya saṃvādaṃ Keśinyarthe Sºnā), 1188, 1190, 1191, 1192, 1193, (1195), 1196, 1197, 1199, (1200), (1202), 1203 (VirocanaSºau), 1205, 1206, 1207 (brahman), (1208), (1211), 1212, (1213), 1217, 1218, (1219), (his rivalry with Virocana on account of Keśinī, cf. § 300).--§ 734 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 26, 1764 (the same?, among the ṛshis who came to see Bhīshma).--§ 747b (Suvarṇotpatti): XIII, 85, 4148 (the eighth of the eight sons of Aṅgiras).--§ 748b (Tārakavadhap.): XIII, 86, 4209 (the same?, gave to Skanda a car and a chariot). Cf. Āṅgirasa.
Sudhanvan^2, a Kuru warrior. § 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 18, 743 (among the Saṃśaptakas, slain by Arjuna). Cf. Sudhanus.

Sudhanvan^3, a Pāñcāla prince. § 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 23, 1002 (Pāñcālyaṃ, proceeded against Droṇa, description of his horses).--§ 599 (Jayadrathavadhap.): VII, 122, 4903 (among the brothers of the Pāñcāla prince Vīraketu; attacked Droṇa). Cf. Pāñcālya.
Sudhanvan^4, an ancient king. § 595 (Shoḍaśarāj. v. Māndhātṛ): VII, 62, 2281 (vanquished by Māndhātṛ).

Sudharmā^1, the sabhā of the Daśārhas (Yādavas), [originally belonging to the gods, but given to Kṛshṇa, v. Harivaṃśa v. 6565 foll.]. § 252 (Subhadrāharaṇap.): I, 220, 7940 (sabhāṃ).--§ 263 (Sabhākriyāp.): II, 3, 84 (Dāśārhī).-§ 793 (Mausalap.): XVI, 7, 183 (Yādavīṃ sabhāṃ).
Sudharman^1, a Vṛshṇi prince. § 264 (Sabhākriyāp.): II, 4, 123 (waited upon Yudhishṭhira), 130 (do., among the Vṛshṇi princes who received instruction in the use of weapons from Arjuna).
Sudharman^2, king of the Daśārṇas. § 280 (Bhīmasena). II, 29, 1063 (Dāśārṇako rājā, in the east, vanquished by Bhīmasena on his digvijaya).
Sudharman^3, a Kuru warrior. § 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 18, 741 (among the Saṃśaptakas).
Sudharman^5 (according to Nīl. the purohita of Duryodhana). § 620 (Śrāddhap.): XI, 26, 779, 782.--§ 637 (Rājadh.): XII, 40, 1447; 44, 1529.
